questions.stem_text: What part do "heuristics" play in the processing of sensory information?

options.A: Heuristics are tools for enhancing sensory acuity
options.C: Heuristics are neurological pathways for sensory processing
options.D: Heuristics are sensory output systems for motor responses
options.E: Heuristics are the primary means of sensory data storage

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Heuristics are tools for enhancing sensory acuity

Numerous factor-analytic studies have been performed on tests of motor function (e.g.,
Purdue Pegboard). In general, these studies have revealed that

options.A: most motor functions are determined by age and gender
options.B: motor functions are independent and do not correlate
options.C: motor functions correlate moderately and form 3 to 4 factors
options.D: most motor functions correlate highly and form a single factor
options.E: most motor functions correlate highly and form 2 single factor

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - most motor functions are determined by age and gender

questions.stem_text: How is incoming sensory verbal information abstracted in terms of classification?

options.A: The nervous system classifies information based on emotional response
options.B: The nervous system classifies information over a period of time
options.C: The nervous system classifies information randomly
options.D: The nervous system classifies information based on the type of senses
options.E: The nervous system classifies information based on previous experiences only

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - The nervous system classifies information over a period of time
